title: Democrats sweep the US midterms, and oil drops 9%. What it means for India
short: Democrats win Congress, oil drops 9%. What it means for India
dek: America's opposition party took both the House and the Senate on 3 November. For India, the vote mattered less for its politics than for what it did to oil, the rupee and bond yields.
card: Brent crude fell 8.7% to $94.62 the day after Democrats won Congress. For an oil importer like India, that was the real headline.
